blocks.text: When configuring SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning for users, you can configure multiple identity providers (IdPs) based on your organization's requirements. The Zscaler service redirects users to different SAML URLs based on configured IdP criteria. The service can support up to 64 different SAML IdPs per organization. To learn more about IdP criteria, see Understanding Identity Provider Criteria. You can manage and view general information about your configured IdPs on the Identity Providers page.
Identity Providers provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure IdPs to authenticate your users.
Provide a quick and simple way for admins to assign multiple users to an IdP.

blocks.text: The Identity Providers page is not available if you're subscribed to the Authentication Service. To learn more, see What Is Authentication Service?
On the Identity Providers page (Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet Authentication Settings > Identity Providers), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Add the Zscaler Client Connector Portal as an IdP.
View a list of all configured IdPs. For each IdP, you can see the following information:
ID: The ID or identifier of the IdP.
Name: The name of the IdP.
Status: Displays if the IdP is enabled or disabled.
Location: The locations mapped to the IdP.
IdP SAML Certificate Expiration Date: The expiration date of the IdP SSL certificate.
Authentication Domains: The domains mapped to the IdP.
Default IdP: Displays whether or not the IdP is the default one. Click to make this IdP the default one.

blocks.text: When an IdP is set as the default, all locations and domains are mapped to it. If you have multiple IdPs configured, the default IdP becomes the catchall IdP, so any location or domain that isn't specifically assigned to an IdP gets mapped to the default one. Also, if you set an existing IdP as the default, the Zscaler service removes any specific location or domain mappings associated with that IdP.
You can't delete the default IdP. You must set another existing IdP as the default.
